subject: Companies Registry Notice for Lotus Garden Trading Limited
body:
Dear Ms Karen Tsang,

We have received a notice from the Companies Registry regarding Lotus Garden Trading Limited, stating that the 2026 annual return was delivered late and demanding payment of a higher registration fee balance. Please settle the balance of HK$765 on or before 21 November 2026.

A scanned copy of the letter is attached for your reference. Please let us know if you would like us to assist you in arranging the payment.

Best regards,
XYZ CPA
